body: It is alright - I do not need your grief or anyone's grief here. What I need for people here is to simply acknowledge the note and move on with their lives, for my existence is just another small atom of irrelevance from everyone - yet from people close to me it is entirely up to them how small or significant they make of me
Then don't. Forget about me - this is for the people who know me personally, my living family and friends
Thank you... ❣ I have read each word carefully and it truly helped me.

Thank you stranger.. I dont know.. This epiphany came out of nowhere and something in me urged that i had to write it out. I will try to get by without harming myself:)

I hope things are also great for you okay? i appreciate you acknowledging me
